name: LaKeel,Inc.
summary: Campus Activewear Limited designs, makes, markets and distributes sports and athleisure footwear, apparel and backpacks for men, women and children in India and abroad. Its CAMPUS-branded range includes sports shoes for fitness and walking, casual footwear, sandals and slippers. Products are sold via e-commerce, distributors, retail and wholesale. Founded in 2005, it is based in Gurugram.
